data.narrative:
Heven AeroTech, a Series B–stage defense and security company founded by Bentzion Levinson, is currently valued at $1.0B post-money on $100M+ in total raised. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) in the Defense & Security sector at equivalent or adjacent stages, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, yielding $1.9B, reflecting typical step-up multiples from Series B to later rounds. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-stage, same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.2B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. This peer cohort anchors the lower end of the implied range.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.1B (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median of $1.6B. The midpoint reflects moderation between stage-progression upside and peer-median positioning. Key uncertainties include the time-to-next-raise, competitive positioning within the $300M–$3.0B peer dispersion, and market demand for defense-sector capital. The current $1.0B valuation sits within but below the triangulated range, suggesting modest upside potential conditional on revenue growth and market momentum.
